name: Ashby
named_for: Founder Josiah Ashby (fictional), who opened the school in 1891
summary: Oxblood banner. Won the House Cup three of the last ten years.
body:
Oxblood banner. Won the House Cup three of the last ten years.

Every student and teacher from Grade 5 up belongs to a house. Houses sit together at Friday lunch and earn points for service, music, sport and the quiz.
